tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh standalone new drawing of the EXACT adopted Bonin fiddler crab in the attached image, used as the SOLE identity, style, anatomy, size and pose reference. Do not edit its pixels. Draw one crab on a true transparent RGBA square around1536px, with the same figure position and proportions as the1254px reference proportionally scaled. This is ONLY a quiet blink: keep both round cream eye discs and eye stalks at the original height, width, positions and spacing; replace only the two brown dot pupils with simple small closed-eye arcs INSIDE the existing discs. Match the original two circular eye OUTER silhouettes exactly; no taller stalks or bigger eyes. Keep the oval shell shape/red-orange-cream colour blocks EXACT, same giant viewer-RIGHT claw size, opening angle, attachment and position, same tiny viewer-LEFT claw, same2claw arms and exactly8walking legs(4on eachside), all original joint curves and support-tip positions. Keep all pose, body/head/claw/leg proportions and the original shell-to-eye and shell-to-giantclaw ratios. Warm brown crisp softlypainted contours and fine papergrain like reference. Absolutely NO glow/halo, shadow, brown cloud, background paint, fake checkerboard or opaque background. No extra or missing legs/claws/eyes, no human face/hands, smile/mouth, fingers, motionmarks, symbols, text, clothing or props. Need full native clarity at inherited249px shellheight; cannot enlarge giantclaw or raise eye stalks for blinking.
